correctness.rationale: A forest has at most one doubly attached leaf. Let d=1+2t, M=d+nt^2 and p=t/d. The probabilities of no bridge and a bridge in a specified pair are w=d/M and b=2t^2/M. Conditional on the bridge identity the two events are independent; the pair mean is 4p^2-Delta times the no-bridge indicator added to the base 4p^2 in the sense that it equals 4p^2-Delta*1_{no bridge}+h*1_{bridge in pair}, with Delta=2p^2 and h=2p-4p^2. The covariance of the two conditional means is Delta^2 w(1-w)+2 Delta h w b-h^2 b^2, giving the displayed rational formula. Independent exact enumeration of K_{2,4} at t=1/3 gave covariance 816/225625, consistent with the formula. Rational differentiation gives the stated negative multiple of F_n. There is just one sign change for n>=4, F_n(0)<0 and F_n(1)=-22n-54<0; the unique positive zero is the maximum, beyond 1. With epsilon=1/n the normalized polynomial at epsilon=0 is t^3(2t+1)(t-1), with derivative 3 at t=1, and its first epsilon coefficient there is -22. The implicit root expansion therefore gives 22/(3n), with O(n^-2) remainder. The rational formula for n times the covariance extends continuously to epsilon=0 near t=1, giving 4/27 at the convergent optimizers. The supplied checker was not run; the finite reproduction does not establish the optimizer or the asymptotics.
